headline: Hyundai Motor Group has set up a new team to plan the business side of its robots, led by the Atlas humanoid, which is due in production from 2028.
score_reason: Corporate reorganisation, informative about direction but no machine or product result.
importance_line: Hyundai's robot makers and customers are affected, as the team is expected to plan Atlas production and sales, but the details come from unnamed industry sources.
summary: Money Today reports, citing industry sources, that Hyundai Motor Group has created an 'RX Business Strategy Team' to plan its global robotics business, expected to focus first on production and deployment of the Atlas humanoid robot made by its affiliate Boston Dynamics and on finding outside buyers. Atlas is scheduled to enter production in 2028 for Hyundai's US car plants.
notes: Organisational story; no machine in action.
